vectors.name: collision_aligned
vectors.description: two DUB answers (7FF0:12345678 and 7FF0:12345687, both 7 preamble bytes) on the wire at once, modelled as wired AND: EUID decodes, ECS does not match -> collision, split the branch
vectors.source: pm_rdm test_rdm_sim.c bus model (bitwise AND of both answers); decode rule rdm-digest.md §3.1
vectors.hex: FE FE FE FE FE FE FE AA FF 7F FA F5 BA 57 BE 75 FE 57 AA 55 AA 5D AE 5D

vectors.name: collision_misaligned

vectors.source: pm_rdm test_rdm_sim.c bus model (bitwise AND of both answers); decode rule rdm-digest.md §3.1
